title: Image Text OCR input
description: Extract printed text from image links or from the images in one of your datasets. Pricing: $0.003 per image with text, counted once per started 20 lines of text (photos, labels and screenshots are almost always one), and $0.001 per analysed image without text. Files that cannot be downloaded, are not images or are blocked are free. Set Maximum cost per run in the run options to cap a run.

imageUrls.title: Image URLs
imageUrls.description: Direct links to images (PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF, BMP, TIFF), up to 15 MB each. Use this, a dataset below, or both.

datasetId.title: Or: one of your Apify datasets
datasetId.description: A dataset in your account, for example the output of a scraper run. It is read only. Each row's image is read and the text is returned with the fields you choose to keep.

imageField.title: Dataset field with the image
imageField.description: The field that holds the image link. Dotted paths work: `images.0.url`, `media.displayUrl`. The field may hold one link, a list of links, or a list of objects with a `url`.

keepFields.title: Dataset fields to keep
keepFields.description: Fields of the source row copied into each result under `row`, for example `id`, `url`, `caption`. Up to 30. Default: none.

maxImagesPerRow.title: Images per dataset row
maxImagesPerRow.description: When the field holds a list, how many images of each row to read.

maxImages.title: Maximum images per run
maxImages.description: The run stops after this many images. It also stops at the maximum cost per run you set in the run options, whichever comes first. With text-heavy pages the cost depends on the amount of text, not only on the number of images.

minConfidence.title: Minimum line confidence
minConfidence.description: Lines the engine is less sure about than this are dropped.

includeLines.title: Return every line with its position
includeLines.description: On: each result has `lines` with text, confidence and a bounding box in original image pixels. Off: only the joined text.

respectRobotsTxt.title: Respect robots.txt of image hosts
respectRobotsTxt.description: On: an image is skipped (free) when its host's robots.txt disallows fetching it. Turn off only for hosts you own or are allowed to fetch.
